operations.details: Verified official OGC CQL2 standard page.
Query/filter precision separated from measurement accuracy.
Selected-record subset not promoted above source quality.
Spatial predicate success not treated as exact HMLR boundary validation.
Verified official OGC DGGS standard page.
DGGS cell identity separated from native sensor footprint and survey accuracy.
DGGS refinement level not treated as LiDAR raster resolution or confidence.
Grid-cell extent not substituted for cadastral title geometry.
CQL2 and DGGS URLs distinct from prior source registry.
No query or grid-cell property substituted for parcel height result.
Canonical manifest untouched; serial publisher required.
